items.title: At least five dead after Amazon plane overruns runway at Miami Airport

children.content: An Amazon cargo plane has barrelled off a runway at Miami International Airport, striking multiple vehicles and bursting into flames in a crash that sent thick black smoke billowing into the sky and forced the closure of all runways at one of the United States's busiest airports.

items.title: Opals remain perfect at World Cup despite 2am fire alarm wake-up call

children.content: The Opals make it two wins from two games at the FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup, beating Türkiye 87-71 after both teams were woken up in the middle of the night by a fire alarm at their hotel.
